title: PSALM 63:7 PRAYER
A SHORT PRAYER

scenes.a: Breathe. This is The Secret Place, and this is the hour we keep.
The Secret Place reads it again, slowly: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
scenes.sub: BECAUSE THOU HAST BEEN MY HELP

scenes.a: The Secret Place reads it again, slowly: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
scenes.sub: THE SECRET PLACE READS IT AGAIN

scenes.a: Lord, The Secret Place comes to You about peaceful rest and sovereign nighttime protection.
What this verse promises is what The Secret Place is asking for on this channel.
scenes.sub: WHAT THIS VERSE PROMISES IS WHAT

scenes.a: Where peaceful rest and sovereign nighttime protection has gone wrong in our lives, stand in for us.
We are not asking for an easier hour at The Secret Place, but for Your hand in it.
scenes.sub: WE ARE NOT ASKING FOR AN EASIER

captions: Breathe. This is The Secret Place, and this is the hour we keep.
The Secret Place reads it again, slowly: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
Lord, The Secret Place comes to You about peaceful rest and sovereign nighttime protection.
What this verse promises is what The Secret Place is asking for on this channel.
Where peaceful rest and sovereign nighttime protection has gone wrong in our lives, stand in for us.
We are not asking for an easier hour at The Secret Place, but for Your hand in it.
Take what The Secret Place just prayed into the rest of your day.
